About us

Meuble Confort & Style is a family furniture store on Plaza Saint-Hubert in Montréal. We sell sectionals, mattresses, bedroom sets and dining sets — and we deliver them ourselves.

Why buy here instead of online

A large online retailer will sell you the same sofa with a three-to-five-week wait and a curbside drop. Ours is fifteen minutes away, in our warehouse, and it can be in your living room within days — assembled, up your stairs, by two people you can call back if something is wrong.

79 reviews, 5 out of 5

That’s our Google rating. We put it on the site because it’s the truest thing we can say about ourselves, and our customers wrote it, not us.
